description: The Godfrey, Raymond and Bohemond 1096 agendas, opening goals, starts, formation and road sheets, Raymond's assurance and the Eastern Undertaking say what is going on at Bouillon, Toulouse, Taranto and on the road to Alexios.

changes.before:
title:'Godfrey: Bouillon and the road ahead', intro:'Keep home government, family and a possible journey distinct. Each review records a priority without selling property, appointing a deputy or creating an expedition.',
    stages:[
      { id:'godfrey_home', name:'The Bouillon holding', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Bouillon is the chosen home within the Verdun map cell. The ducal description grants no authority over every church or town of Lower Lotharingia. Review actual possessions through ordinary government.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_review_home', label:'Keep home obligations in view', detail:'Record this priority without changing holdings or church rights.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_kin', name:'Kin and current officers', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Ida, Eustace III and Baldwin remain separate people. Review living relatives and current officers before considering departure. Kinship does not make a brother your deputy.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_household', label:'Retain the present household arrangements', detail:'Move nobody and appoint no officer. Ordinary appointments retain their own authority and costs.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_funding', name:'Lawful resources', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Review current funds and ordinary obligations before any journey. No property sale, mortgage, extraordinary collection or payment by a community is part of this review.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_funds', label:'Preserve the current resources', detail:'Record a funding priority without collecting or spending money.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_plans', name:'Home or a journey', year:1096, season:1,
        text:'You may remain at home or inspect ordinary personal travel. Where separate formation and road cards are present, review actual authorization, public or private funding, training and provisions there. This priority creates no command or vow. An ordinary personal journey moves only its actual traveller.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_stay', label:'Prioritize home government', detail:'Continue the review without starting a journey.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'godfrey_consider_road', label:'Consider ordinary travel separately', detail:'Record interest only. Use the ordinary journey review for its current destination, price and restrictions.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_position', name:'The actual position', year:1096, season:2,
        text:'Check your present location and any real journey. This date does not put you at Constantinople or make a route safe. Being away does not move the household or settle home obligations.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_position', label:'Review the present position', detail:'Record a priority without arrival, family movement or a route agreement.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_obligations', name:'Changing home obligations', year:1096, season:3,
        text:'Current office, possession and living officers determine what can be administered. A departure gives no extra remote powers, and this review cannot install a replacement ruler.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_obligations', label:'Retain ordinary administration', detail:'Leave all actual authority and costs with ordinary government.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_relations', name:'Foreign approaches', year:1097, season:0,
        text:'Anna Komnene describes Godfrey’s undertaking concerning former imperial possessions. The exact receiving authority and territorial scope are not supplied here, so this context transfers no land. Current diplomacy and passage retain their own reviews; this priority accepts no oath or religious vow.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_relations', label:'Leave negotiations to ordinary diplomacy', detail:'Create no audience, homage, passage, protection or treaty.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_continuation', name:'Government continues', year:1097, season:1,
        text:'Conclude at your actual location with current holdings and obligations. Home life, an existing journey or an ordinary war continues under its own rules. No Jerusalem crown or historical result is awarded.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_continue', label:'Continue with the present affairs', detail:'Complete these personal reviews without rewards or changes to any live obligation.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'godfrey_finish', label:'Conclude the opening program', detail:'Close only this personal program.', operation:'agenda_finish' }] }
changes.after:
title:'Godfrey: Bouillon and the road ahead', intro:'You hold Lower Lotharingia for Henry IV from your castle at Bouillon in 1096, and the call to march east has reached your court. These priorities shape your court’s story; orders, payments and wars go through Rank & Realm, Land and the map.',
    stages:[
      { id:'godfrey_home', name:'Bouillon and Verdun', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Bouillon is your home castle, and Verdun is the land you govern from it. The bishops and towns of Lower Lotharingia answer to you only in part.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_review_home', label:'Look to Bouillon and Verdun first', detail:'You turn to the needs of your home lands.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_kin', name:'Ida, Eustace and Baldwin', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Your mother Ida and your brothers Eustace III and Baldwin each have their own plans. Hear them before you decide whether to leave; a brother governs for you only if you appoint him.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_household', label:'Let your brothers choose their own road', detail:'You leave Eustace and Baldwin free to join you or stay.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_funding', name:'Paying for the road', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'A march east would cost more than your purse holds. Your court’s funds and gifts from supporters can pay for it; you cannot sell or pledge Bouillon here.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_funds', label:'Guard your treasury for now', detail:'You keep your money for home needs until a plan is set.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_plans', name:'Home or the road east', year:1096, season:1,
        text:'You can stay at Bouillon or take the road east. If your Deeds list a following to raise and a road to march, each has its own sheet with its own costs; you can also make the journey alone.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_stay', label:'Stay and govern from Bouillon', detail:'You put Lower Lotharingia’s affairs ahead of the road east.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'godfrey_consider_road', label:'Weigh the road east', detail:'You turn your thoughts to the march; nothing moves until you raise a following or set out.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_position', name:'Where you stand', year:1096, season:2,
        text:'Check where you and your household are. The road through Hungary to Constantinople is long, and nothing guarantees a safe arrival.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_position', label:'Take stock of where you stand', detail:'You turn to your position and the state of the road.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_obligations', name:'Ruling from afar', year:1096, season:3,
        text:'Whatever you hold still needs governing while you are away. Leaving gives you no extra power at a distance, and nobody takes your place unless you appoint them.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_obligations', label:'Keep Lower Lotharingia governed', detail:'You turn to keeping your lands in order while plans change.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_relations', name:'Alexios at Constantinople', year:1097, season:0,
        text:'Alexios will expect the leaders who reach Constantinople to swear to return the cities Byzantium has lost.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_keep_relations', label:'Leave the oath until you meet Alexios', detail:'You will settle terms with Alexios only if you reach him.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'godfrey_continuation', name:'The year ahead', year:1097, season:1,
        text:'The opening agenda ends here, wherever you stand. Your lands, your household and any march or war carry on; no crown at Jerusalem comes with it.',
        choices:[{ id:'godfrey_continue', label:'Carry on with your affairs', detail:'You close these reviews and keep ruling as before.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'godfrey_finish', label:'End the opening agenda', detail:'Your remaining reviews close; your rule goes on.', operation:'agenda_finish' }] }

changes.before:
title:'Raymond: Toulouse and future commitments', intro:'Review present government, household and the choice to stay or consider a personal journey. No following, eastern possession or imperial promise is supplied by a priority.',
    stages:[
      { id:'raymond_home', name:'The Toulouse court', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Toulouse is the chosen home anchor. Review the holdings actually represented by the court, keeping county-scale government distinct from every local estate, church and viscounty.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_review_home', label:'Prioritize present home government', detail:'Record a priority without extending the court’s possessions.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_resources', name:'Public resources and local rights', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Ordinary government owns current receipts, spending and public duties. No regional title authorizes taking church property or charging a new contribution through this program.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_resources', label:'Keep the ordinary resource arrangements', detail:'Collect and spend nothing through this review.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_family', name:'Household and succession', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Elvira is Raymond’s spouse; Bertrand is his son from an earlier marriage. Review their actual availability. No infant is seeded and no deputy mandate is created by naming an heir.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_family', label:'Retain the household’s present arrangements', detail:'Move nobody, appoint no deputy and impose no later succession.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_plans', name:'Stay or consider the road', year:1096, season:1,
        text:'Remaining at home is a complete choice. Where separate formation and road cards are present, they review current local consent, real money and supplies. An ordinary personal journey uses its own route and price. This priority recruits nobody and moves neither Elvira nor Bertrand.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_stay', label:'Keep home government first', detail:'Continue without travel or a vow.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'raymond_consider_road', label:'Consider a personal journey separately', detail:'Record interest only; ordinary travel owns departure, costs and arrival.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_position', name:'Current location and funds', year:1096, season:2,
        text:'Review the actual traveller, current resources and lawful access. The calendar guarantees no Alpine crossing, host arrival or safe destination.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_position', label:'Review the real position', detail:'Supply no funds, route or family movement.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_obligations', name:'Home duties while plans change', year:1096, season:3,
        text:'The living incumbent and current possessions govern home administration. A journey does not automatically surrender Toulouse or appoint Bertrand to rule it.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_obligations', label:'Continue ordinary administration', detail:'Record the priority without changing office or possession.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_relations', name:'Distinct foreign commitments', year:1097, season:0,
        text:'Raymond of Aguilers distinguishes a personal life-and-honor assurance from homage. Where the separate limited-assurance card is present, actual formation and original living parties govern its finite costless records review. It grants no protection, passage or land. This priority accepts neither assurance nor homage.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_relations', label:'Leave foreign terms for a real negotiation', detail:'Create no oath, passage arrangement, treaty or eastern claim.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_continuation', name:'Present affairs continue', year:1097, season:1,
        text:'Close the opening at the real location with the household and holdings that actually remain. No Tripoli possession, forced home succession or return journey follows from this conclusion.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_continue', label:'Continue present affairs', detail:'Complete the reviews without a reward, relocation or settlement of a live war.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'raymond_finish', label:'Conclude the opening program', detail:'Close only this personal program.', operation:'agenda_finish' }] }
changes.after:
title:'Raymond: Toulouse and future commitments', intro:'You rule Toulouse in 1096 with Elvira at your side, and Pope Urban looks to you to lead the south on the march east. These priorities shape your court’s story; orders, payments and wars go through Rank & Realm, Land and the map.',
    stages:[
      { id:'raymond_home', name:'The Toulouse court', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'You govern Toulouse and the lands its court holds. The viscounts, bishops and abbeys of the south keep their own rights.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_review_home', label:'Put the Toulouse court first', detail:'You turn to governing Toulouse and its lands.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_resources', name:'Money and church rights', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Your revenues and duties at Toulouse come first. Church lands and new taxes are not yours to take for a march.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_resources', label:'Live within Toulouse’s revenues', detail:'You keep spending to what your court already collects.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_family', name:'Elvira and Bertrand', year:1096, season:0,
        text:'Elvira of Castile is your wife; Bertrand is your son from an earlier marriage. Naming Bertrand your heir does not let him rule while you are away; that needs an appointment.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_family', label:'Keep Elvira and Bertrand where they are', detail:'You turn to your household and leave its places unchanged.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_plans', name:'Stay or take the road', year:1096, season:1,
        text:'You can stay in Toulouse or take the road east. If your Deeds list a following to raise and a road to march, each has its own sheet with its own costs. Elvira and Bertrand are not counted among the following.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_stay', label:'Keep Toulouse first', detail:'You put home government ahead of the road east.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'raymond_consider_road', label:'Weigh the road east', detail:'You turn your thoughts to the march; nothing moves until you raise a following or set out.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_position', name:'Where you stand', year:1096, season:2,
        text:'Check where you are and what you can spend. Nothing guarantees a crossing of the Alps or a safe road through Dalmatia.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_position', label:'Take stock before the road', detail:'You turn to your position, your purse and the road ahead.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_obligations', name:'Toulouse while you are away', year:1096, season:3,
        text:'You keep governing Toulouse as long as you hold it. Leaving does not hand it to Bertrand unless you appoint him.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_obligations', label:'Keep Toulouse governed', detail:'You turn to keeping Toulouse in order while plans change.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_relations', name:'Alexios and your oath', year:1097, season:0,
        text:'Alexios will ask the leaders who reach Constantinople to do him homage. Raymond of Aguilers says you would swear only to respect his life and honor; once your following forms, that offer may have its own sheet in Deeds.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_keep_relations', label:'Settle terms with Alexios face to face', detail:'You will answer Alexios only if you reach Constantinople.', operation:'agenda_priority' }] },
      { id:'raymond_continuation', name:'The year ahead', year:1097, season:1,
        text:'The opening agenda ends here, wherever you stand. Your lands, your household and any march or war carry on; no lordship at Tripoli comes with it.',
        choices:[{ id:'raymond_continue', label:'Carry on with your affairs', detail:'You close these reviews and keep ruling as before.', operation:'agenda_priority' },
          { id:'raymond_finish', label:'End the opening agenda', detail:'Your remaining reviews close; your rule goes on.', operation:'agenda_finish' }] }

changes.before:
title:'Godfrey: optional formation at home',
    intro:'Review the real local authority, separate public grant or voluntary private gift, training and fourteen days of actual rations. The demonstration roster is 320 fighters and 320 civilians, including its original principal. No property sale, levy withdrawal, religious vow or route permission follows from preparation. You may wait, refuse or stop.',
changes.after:
title:'Godfrey: raising a following at Bouillon',
    intro:'Raise a following of about 320 fighters and 320 others at Bouillon. You need your court’s leave, money for training and fourteen days of food before anyone marches. You can wait or stop at any time.',

changes.before:
title:'Godfrey: a conditional first road',
    intro:'After paid formation, request separate finite permissions around Verdun and Trier. The first camp leg is a playable staging choice, not an attested itinerary. Every county on the actual path needs current permission. One optional purchase uses real money and stock; it cannot sustain an entire eastern journey. Further northern and Danube travel needs new ordinary route and access reviews. Wait, pause, redirect manually or stop without surrendering the home office.',
changes.after:
title:'Godfrey: the first road to Trier',
    intro:'Once your following is trained, ask whoever holds Verdun, Luxembourg, Metz and Trier for passage and march the camp to Trier. You can buy food once on the way, but not enough for the whole journey east. Every road beyond Trier needs its own permission, and you can pause, change course or stop without losing Bouillon.',

changes.before:
title:'Raymond: optional formation at Toulouse',
    intro:'The bounded demonstration roster contains 320 fighters and 480 civilians, including its original principal. Local authorization, an actual public grant or voluntary private contribution, paid training and fourteen days of actual rations remain separate reviews. Elvira and Bertrand are not enrolled by these cohort numbers. No departure, deputy appointment or eastern possession is supplied. Waiting or refusing leaves home government available.',
changes.after:
title:'Raymond: raising a following at Toulouse',
    intro:'Raise a following of about 320 fighters and 480 others at Toulouse; Elvira and Bertrand are not among them. You need your court’s leave, money for training and fourteen days of food before anyone marches. You can wait or stop at any time.',

changes.before:
title:'Raymond: review the overland approach',
    intro:'The initial camp leg toward Narbonne is a simulation staging choice, not proof of a historical western road or an Adriatic crossing. Each actual holder must separately accept finite passage. A successful first leg grants no onward permission. Further overland and Adriatic destinations require their own current reviews. Supplies, home authority, civilian position and the field host remain distinct; pause, wait or stop when plans change.',
changes.after:
title:'Raymond: the first road to Narbonne',
    intro:'Once your following is trained, ask whoever holds Toulouse, Carcassonne and Narbonne for passage and march the camp to Narbonne. Every road beyond, overland or across the Adriatic, needs its own permission. You can pause, wait or stop when plans change.',

changes.before:
title:'Bohemond: optional formation at Taranto',
    intro:'Review a simulation formation of 240 fighters and 240 civilians, including its original principal. The home lordships, private purse and expedition account remain separate. Authorization creates no funds; a gift or grant creates no consent. Formation buys real training and a fourteen-day ration target once. No Tancred, companion household, ship or future title is added. Staying, waiting and refusal remain complete alternatives.',
changes.after:
title:'Bohemond: raising a following at Taranto',
    intro:'Raise a following of about 240 fighters and 240 others at Taranto. You need your court’s leave, a grant from your treasury or a gift from your purse for training, and fourteen days of food before anyone marches. You can wait or stop at any time.',

changes.before:
title:'Bohemond: a conditional coastal approach',
    intro:'The first camp leg toward the Bari county is a playable staging choice. It selects no historical embarkation port and supplies no boat, sea crossing or landing at Durazzo or Valona. Real local permission, money and stores govern the road. Further travel requires separate ordinary reviews. A field-only manual order cannot move the civilian camp, and stopping intent does not return anyone home.',
changes.after:
title:'Bohemond: the coast road to Bari',
    intro:'Once your following is trained, ask whoever holds Taranto, Brindisi and Bari for passage and march the camp to Bari. This road brings no ships, so crossing to Durazzo or Valona needs its own plan. Moving only your fighters leaves the camp behind, and stopping sends nobody home.',

changes.before:
name:'Raymond: the limited assurance in the accounts',

name:'Raymond: an oath to respect Alexios',
    desc:'Alexios wants the western leaders bound to him by oath, but you will not become his man. Once your following forms, you can swear instead to respect his life and honor, and either of you may refuse.',
